source_refs.note: Exercise 11.3, Question 3: light-house 100 m, angles of depression 17 and 19 degrees; distance between the ships. Answer key PDF 309 (printed 36.78 m corrected).

blocks.prompt: 3 A man on the top of a 100 m high light-house is in line with two ships on the same side of it, whose angles of depression from the man are \(17^{\circ}\) and \(19^{\circ}\) respectively. Find the distance between the ships.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh heights and distances ka sawal hai jis mein angles of depression (neeche dekhne ke zaviye) diye hain.
Humein do jahazon ke darmiyan faasla chahiye.
Plan: \(\cot\) se har jahaz ka light-house ke paon (foot) se faasla nikalein, phir dono ka farq.
Sochiye: aap light-house ki choti par khare hain aur samundar mein do jahaz ek seedh mein nazar aa rahe hain. Jo jahaz door hai use dekhne ke liye nazar kam jhukti hai, aur jo qareeb hai us ke liye zyada.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: light-house ki unchai \(AB = 100\) m; angles of depression \(17^{\circ}\) (door wala jahaz C) aur \(19^{\circ}\) (qareeb wala jahaz D); dono jahaz ek hi taraf.
Humein find karna hai: \(CD\), yani jahazon ka darmiyani faasla.
Tareeqa: Angle of depression (upar se horizontal line se neeche dekhne ka zaviya) barabar hota hai jahaz se upar dekhne ke angle of elevation ke, kyunke yeh alternate angles hain (horizontal line aur zameen parallel hain). Har right triangle mein \(\text{base} = \text{height} \times \cot(\text{angle})\).

Figure banayein
Kyun: Pehle figure, phir hisaab: yeh heights and distances ka sunehri usool hai. Chhota angle (\(17^{\circ}\)) door wale jahaz C ka hai: door ki cheez dekhne ke liye nazar kam jhukani parti hai. Is liye \(BC > BD\) aur \(CD = BC - BD\).
Dhyan dein: Angles ulte jahazon ko de diye to faasla negative aayega; yeh nishani hai ke labels ghalat hain.

Door wale jahaz ka faasla
\[\tan 17^{\circ} = \dfrac{AB}{BC}\]
\[BC = 100\cot 17^{\circ}\]
\[= 100 \times 3.2709 = 327.09 \text{ m}\]
Kyun: Right triangle ABC mein C par angle \(17^{\circ}\) hai. \(\tan = \frac{\text{perpendicular}}{\text{base}}\), yahan perpendicular light-house ki unchai 100 m hai aur base \(BC\) humein chahiye. Dono taraf se ulta kar ke \(BC = 100 \div \tan 17^{\circ} = 100\cot 17^{\circ}\).

Qareeb wale jahaz ka faasla
\[BD = 100\cot 19^{\circ}\]
\[= 100 \times 2.9042 = 290.42 \text{ m}\]
Kyun: Bilkul wohi tareeqa triangle ABD mein, jahan D par angle \(19^{\circ}\) hai. Bara angle, chhota faasla: \(290.42 < 327.09\), jo figure se milta hai.

Farq nikalein
\[CD = BC - BD\]
\[= 100(\cot 17^{\circ} - \cot 19^{\circ})\]
\[\approx 327.09 - 290.42\]
\[\approx 36.66 \text{ m}\]
Kyun: Dono jahaz ek hi line par aur ek hi taraf hain, is liye un ka darmiyani faasla bare faasle mein se chhota minus karne se milta hai. Agar jahaz light-house ke mukhtalif taraf hote to dono faasle jama karte; is liye sawal mein "same side" ko ghaur se parhein. Calculator mein seedha \(100(\cot 17^{\circ} - \cot 19^{\circ})\) karein to \(36.664\ldots\) aata hai, yani 36.66 m.

Tasdeeq
\[\tan^{-1}\!\left(\tfrac{100}{327.09}\right) \approx 17.0^{\circ} \;\checkmark\]
\[\tan^{-1}\!\left(\tfrac{100}{290.42}\right) \approx 19.0^{\circ} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Nikale hue faaslon se angles wapas nikale to wohi \(17^{\circ}\) aur \(19^{\circ}\) aaye, is liye dono faasle sahi hain. Exam mein yeh check do line ka hai magar ghalti pakarne mein bahut kaam aata hai.
blocks.final_answer: Jahazon ke darmiyan faasla \(\approx 36.66\) m (taqreeban 36.7 m)

answer_figure.alt: To-scale drawing: a 100 m light-house AB stands at the right with the man at its top A. A dashed horizontal line goes left from A. Two lines of sight go down to the ships: to D at 19 degrees below the horizontal and to C, farther left, at 17 degrees. BD is about 290.42 m and the gap CD is about 36.66 m.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein distance \(= 36.78\) m chhapa hai, jo ghalat hai. \(100(\cot 17^{\circ} - \cot 19^{\circ}) = 100(3.27085 - 2.90421) = 36.66\) m banta hai (chaar hindson wali tables se 36.67 m). Sahi faasla taqreeban 36.66 m hai.
